description: Writable state-disk filesystem support matrix for the microvm profile. support: supported = in-tree and writable; experimental = out-of-tree/unverified (validate warns); unsupported = rejected by validate. Tools listed are what `genoa build` needs on the BUILD host to format the state image; a disk whose tools are absent is reported as requires-host and the build fails closed (no placeholder hash is ever reported as built).

freebsd.notes: UFS2; soft updates or SU+J selectable via options.journal

netbsd.notes: FFSv2; WAPBL journaling is a mount option (-o log), fss(4) for persistent snapshots

freebsd.notes: LFS is not in the FreeBSD tree

netbsd.notes: in-tree log-structured FS; checkpoints are the version candidate (smolfire #63)

freebsd.notes: out-of-tree port (T. Kusumi); confirm write support before relying on it

netbsd.notes: out-of-tree port (T. Kusumi); confirm write support before relying on it
